lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to warn Pharaoh of frogs if he refuses to let His people go.
Aaron stretches out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs cover the land.
Pharaoh asks Moses to pray for the frogs to go, and Moses says they will remain only in the Jordan.
Moses cries out to the LORD, and frogs in the houses, courtyards, and vineyards die, but Pharaoh hardens his heart.
Aaron strikes the dust and it becomes gnats, the magicians cannot copy it, and they call it God's finger.
